name: capability-release-lifecycle-exposure-promotion
title: Product capability release lifecycle: live backfill + candidate exposure + evidence-based promotion (B-8128 follow-up)
description: B-8128 V1 (DONE, merged, CLI 0.3.162) shipped the product-capability-release foundation: the git-tracked capability-releases.jsonl ledger, the DONE classifier at both completion sites, merge-stable binding, optional playbook-lineage widening, and read-only capability_release_list/status. It PROVED the M6/M7/backfill semantics hermetically and ASSERTED that the safety invariants stay intact, but deferred three OPERATIONAL pieces to this follow-up story. This story turns those proven semantics into live, user-usable machinery: (1) a real capability_release_backfill CLI that enriches the already-existing B-785e artifact release + PBP-882 candidate (still under-bound with only 3-field lineage); (2) the M6 candidate pending-learning EXPOSURE surfaces + exposure records so an inert candidate can finally be shown in a controlled, non-active way; (3) the M7 structured-outcome + evidence-based promotion recommendation commands so a candidate can move candidate -> exposed -> outcome -> promoted only on concrete evidence. Ref: docs/requirements/decisions/product-capability-release-playbook-lineage-execution-plan.md (M6, M7, M8, and the Follow-up Story section).
